facts.fact: A project launched on 6 March 2026 is to provide a digital solution and equipment for financial management and collection of communal taxes to pilot communes, starting with Koutiala; no count of communes is given.
facts.system: digital financial and accounting management solution (Koutiala project)

facts.fact: The Koutiala project is financed by the Embassy of the Netherlands and carried with the NGO ID Sahel Afrique, with no domestic budget line stated.

facts.fact: The project is run by the commune of Koutiala in partnership with the NGO ID Sahel Afrique, which supports the digital tools.
